en-US.description: Recording, editing and mixing audio: an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Avid Pro Tools, rebuilt in pure Rust.
en-US.longDescription: SoundCraft is an open-source digital audio workstation for recording, editing and mixing audio, a clean-room reimplementation of Avid Pro Tools written from scratch in pure Rust. It is MIT OR Apache-2.0 licensed and runs natively on Windows, macOS and Linux.
en-US.name: SoundCraft
en-US.releaseNotes:
## What's Changed
* Grant network access so update checks can reach GitHub by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1163
* Honor CARGO_BUILD_TARGET in FreeBSD packaging for aarch64 release builds by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1167
* Reject out-of-range timecode fields so Min:Secs strings fall through by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1024
* Count only audio-track clips in session text export by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1025
* Strip XML-forbidden characters from MusicXML/SVG score export by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1061
* Keep clip spacing when moving a group left past the session start by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1062
* Cut BWF bext text fields at UTF-8 character boundaries by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1110
* Clamp clip fades after elastic warp and remove warp by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1123
* Keep crossfade overlaps when pasting clips by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1137
* Keep MIDI note spacing when moving notes left past tick 0 by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1138
* Report the decoded length for AAC in MP4 in audio-io probe by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1141
* Check the rewritten DSP paths against the algorithms they replaced by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1153
* Reply with Invalid Request to empty batches and non-object messages by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1160
* Fix stale end on a Memory Location added during playback by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1161
* Return Error::Invalid for overflowing H.264 slice header values by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1182
* Saturate and clamp session start in setup.current_timecode by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1169
* Fix exit status after kept-going script errors by @DAnaeto in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1145
* Bound the source span of stretch renders (fixes #895) by @ayozetr in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1148
* Audio import: regression test for oversized Matroska element sizes (fixes #878) by @ayozetr in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1149
* Calculate velocity ramps across the full tick range by @TheGalitube in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1171
* Clamp the minimum beat before conversion by @TheGalitube in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1172
* track.delete: keep a folder's input bus when surviving tracks route through it by @CloudCorpRecords in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1026
* Reject VST3 bus layouts beyond host limits instead of truncating by @luigiPinna in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1178
* Route sequential H.264 sample reads through the 256 MiB cap by @luigiPinna in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1179
* Avoid cloning sessions when checking unsaved changes by @reoniazx in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1181
* setup.playback_engine / setup.hardware: apply device and buffer in the app, don't claim it headless by @sanderdewijs in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1077
* Web: Check for Updates opens its window, with no dead_code warnings in xtask wasm by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1103
* Engine: wasm32 clippy reports no drop_non_drop in autosave and backups by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1106
* Strip Silence: closing the window while Mix shows stops the rectangle scan by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft/pull/1095
* Shift selection memory location ends on Cut Time and Insert Time by @Silvert
